# L&M Enterprises & SAGO Gas Bar

> Independent convenience store, tobacco retailer, and full-service gas station on Tyendinaga Mohawk Territory at 39–43 Dundas Street, Deseronto, ON.

## Core Facts
- **Business Names**: L&M Enterprises (Convenience Store) & SAGO Gas Bar (Fuel Station)
- **Address**: 39–43 Dundas Street, Deseronto, ON K0K 1X0, Canada
- **Territory**: Tyendinaga Mohawk Territory
- **Phone**: +1 (613) 396-2224
- **Website**: https://www.lnmenterprises.ca
- **Hours**: Open 7 days a week, 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM daily
- **Fuel Offerings**: Full-service Regular Gasoline, Premium 91 Gasoline, Clear Diesel, and Dyed Farm Diesel at tax-free competitive prices.
- **Convenience Store Offerings**: Tobacco, cigars, vape hardware, cold drinks, snacks, groceries, lottery, and automotive supplies.
- **Plaza Complex**: 39–45 Dundas Street (shares the plaza with Mohawk Medibles cannabis dispensary and The Stoned Chef food truck). Park once for gas, food, and shopping.
